description: Two-boundary geometry: a centered annulus with exact radii.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Requirements: (1) draw a centered filled blue ring; (2) inner radius is 0.18 and outer radius is 0.30 of frame height; (3) the center and outside are near-black; (4) both boundaries are hard; (5) the shader is static and ignores iTime; (6) no NaN output.
